_about: Architecture-mode figures written in arch.js (programme figures live in arch_programs.json). Register ids per entry.

poolDeck._note: deck all round: 1.2 m BC guideline s. 3.2; 1.8 m NBC(AE) 7.2.3.15

i2Office._note: I-2: general and health care office together, the greater of 235 m² or 33.3 % of all floor area

dcTemp._note: data-hall heat temperature by cooling type, °C; the liquid figure is marked unverified (?) in arch.js

storeyMin._note: Vancouver I-3 s. 3.1.2.9 (p. 12): floor-to-floor at least 6.0 m on the first floor and 4.0 m on floors above (buildings after 31 Oct 2017). Used for program storeys on I-3 lots. Elsewhere a program's own storey height has no source (?): it is drawn at the hall's 6.0 m (engine R.ftf; register envelope, burlingtonPlans2026).

roofEquip._note: Edmonton Bylaw 20001 s. 5.70 1.9: ventilating equipment and mechanical penthouses have no Height limit (dry coolers and chillers: our reading). Vancouver ZDBL s. 10.1.1: the Director of Planning may permit mechanical equipment and its screening above the height limit.

belowGrade._note: A basement counts toward floor area (Vancouver I-3 4.1.1; Edmonton FAR unless storage or service to the building) but not toward height or storeys (NBC 1.4.1.2; Edmonton Storey definition). FM 5-32 2.6.4.3.1 and 2.6.4.4.1.1 (insurer guidance): no generators or diesel tanks in basements or on the roof.
